name: Hurriyet Gazetecilik ve Matbaacilik A.S.
summary: Hürriyet Gazetecilik ve Matbaacilik A.S. engages in journalism, printing, advertising, and Internet publishing activities primarily in Turkey, Russia, and Europe. The company prints and publishes newspapers; and provides online services. It is also involved in TV production and marketing, distribution, book publishing, and investment activities. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. Hürriyet Gazetecilik ve Matbaacilik A.S. is a subsidiary of Demirören Medya Yatirimlari Ticaret A.S.
